components.name: Lifecycle Line
components.description: Signature: parts as nodes on one dashed blue edge, in work order; the active node fills.
components.css: .ds-line { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-line::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: calc(7px + 0.375rem - 0.75px); left: 7px; right: calc(33.3% - 7px); border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--accent); } .ds-stop { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: start; row-gap: 0.375rem; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.375rem 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--fg); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg); transition: background 150ms, transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stage { color: var(--fg-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-stop-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-stop:hover .ds-stop-title { color: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-stop[aria-current] .ds-dot { background: var(--accent); transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-stop[aria-current] .ds-stop-title { font-weight: 700; } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Checklist Step
components.description: A step on a hairline with a square tick that fills ink when done.
components.css: .ds-step { display: flex; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.55rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; } .ds-step input { flex: none; width: 15px; height: 15px; margin: 0.25rem 0 0; border: 1.5px solid var(--fg-subtle); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg); appearance: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-step input:checked { border-color: var(--fg); background: var(--fg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--bg); } .ds-step input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-step:has(input:checked) > span { color: var(--fg-muted); }

narrative.overview:
Every page is drawn the way its owner would present a system he runs. A section is a figure of that system with an annotation layer on top: nodes, dashed edges between them, hairline rules between rows of text, and numbers attached to the thing they measure. The ground is a cool, near-white grey (deep blue-black in dark mode); Inter at heavy display weights carries the claims, and JetBrains Mono appears only where a technical drawing would put small print: dates, durations, stage labels, counts, code.

Density follows the work. The hero and lists are dense; figures (the capability map, the career route, the Studio lifecycle line, the system map) get the most air and are the visual peaks. One blue does all the signalling: the active node, the live edge, a hovered link. Everything else is ink at three strengths. Depth is almost absent; structure comes from rules, alignment and the line that threads the parts in order.

Motion is authored once per section and always additive: the default state is the final state, so a reader with reduced motion or no JavaScript sees the complete page. The homepage carries one ambient layer (a WebGL particle field behind the hero and map); no other surface has a backdrop.
keyCharacteristics: Nodes and dashed edges in place of cards; a boxed container exists only as a node inside a figure.
One accent hue (blue, hue 252) for state and direction, never for decoration.
Heavy Inter headings with tight negative tracking; mono reserved for apparatus.
Hairline dividers (1px) between rows and parts; no borders or backgrounds on lists of text.
Light and dark are both first-class, toggled by `data-theme`, with a system option.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue marks state or direction (active, live, hovered, next). If removing the blue would lose no information, it should not be blue.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy comes from `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle`, not from new greys or opacity on text.

rules.name: The Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Mono is for dates, measurements, stage labels and code. Never for section labels, prose, buttons or pills, and never uppercase-tracked.

rules.name: The Diacritic Rule
rules.body: Vietnamese headings open up to line-height 1.12 (`:lang(vi)`); stacked diacritics must never touch the line above.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element sits above the page (menu, dialog, toast). Content, figures and nodes never cast one.

dos: **Do** draw relationships as nodes and dashed edges in `signal-blue`; keep the edge in work order.
**Do** put every number on the node, edge or sentence it measures, with its condition (p95, in 3 months, 18M+ MAU).
**Do** separate rows and parts with 1px `hairline` rules and leave lists of text unboxed.
**Do** cap prose at 62 to 64ch and balance headings.
**Do** give each section one authored moment, use `--ease` (expo out) at 150 or 250ms for UI and 500 to 800ms for figure draws, and guard every keyframe with `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** design light and dark together; dark accents are lighter and text on them is dark (`--fg-on-accent`).
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px and focus rings at 2px blue.
donts: **Don't** use cards: no bordered or shaded box around text that is not a node in a figure, and no card inside a card.
**Don't** put eyebrows, kickers or category labels above headings; headings speak for themselves as claims.
**Don't** use gradient text or gradient fills on surfaces, borders or buttons. The dot grid and the hero's faint backdrop halo are the only gradients, and they are texture, not fill.
**Don't** use chips or pills for tags, tech lists or labels; write them as a muted line.
**Don't** set mono in uppercase with wide tracking, or use it for anything but apparatus.
**Don't** add hero-metric grids, stat cards or fake sparklines.
